text:
emily-peopleops: Heads up 30 Samir (current SWE intern) conversion needs final sign-off. Manager requested: L3 base $135k (above midpoint), one-time sign-on $12k, prorated equity first year, benefits active 6/1 if accepted. Need comp routing + payroll/legal check.

chris-recruit: Candidate accepts verbally pending written offer. Manager pushed for fast timeline.

manish-mgr: Quick context: project-critical infra skill + counteroffer risk from competitor. Sign-on is to secure acceptance. Prefer 6-month clawback but open to 12 if that's policy.

lia-peopleops: For routing: I'll prepare an exception packet. Need manager justification (paste), headcount code, and expected start date.

manish-mgr: Justification pasted: "critical infra repo ownership, months to backfill, strong external interest". Start 6/1. Headcount: ENG-2026-03-AWS-FT.

finance-ops: Quick calc: base $135k + sign-on $12k = $147k first-year cash. Marking as hiring premium. Approve to send to committee if manager justification OK.

payroll-bot: payroll action: to enable benefits 6/1 we need signed offer + new-hire packet in HRIS by close of business Wed. Off-cycle equity proration requires equity team note.

emily-peopleops: Adding sample offer snippet below (for legal):

```
Base: $135,000/year
Sign-on: $12,000 one-time (clawback if employment terminates within 6 months of start)
Equity: 1500 RSUs, prorated for first year, standard 1y cliff / quarterly thereafter
Start date: 2026-06-01
Benefits: Active from start date pending payroll enrollment
```

legal-bot: Draft note: 6-month clawback generally enforceable in WA but include clear repayment terms and timing. Recommend repayment schedule and a reconciliation clause. If candidate negotiates, offer 12-month instead.

talent-ops: Would prefer standardized language. If legal OKs 6 months, add clause: "repayment due within 60 days of termination; company will deduct if permitted by law."

lia-peopleops: I'll route to recruiting lead -> finance -> people-ops committee. If committee approves, legal will finalize language and people-ops will issue the offer.

chris-recruit: Candidate ETA to sign: likely within 24-48 hrs after offer email.

finance-ops: Budget hold lifted conditionally. Please tag code ENG-2026-03-AWS-FT in packet.

payroll-bot: Reminder: new-hire payroll enrollment window closes Wed COB to guarantee 6/1 benefits.

emily-peopleops: OK routing started. Will post committee decision here. Keep messages short pls. :+1:

lia-peopleops: Committee meeting in 90m. If approved, we'll push final offer same day.

legal-bot: Reviewing now. Will post redlines within the hour.

emily-peopleops: Thanks all. Archiving update after offer accepted.
